name: Raon-1 mini config.json
notes: Fetched 2026-11-25. model_type raon1_mini, auto_map provides custom AutoConfig/AutoModel/AutoModelForCausalLM (trust_remote_code or the KRAFTON transformers fork required). hidden 2,560, 25 layers, 40 heads, head_dim 128, vocab 259,840, no rope_scaling, rope_parameters null (NoPE), hidden_act situ (beta 4.0, linear_beta 25.0). MoE: 128 experts, 6 per token, 1 shared, moe_intermediate_size 1,088, sigmoid router with renormalise and routed_scaling_factor 1.0, first_k_dense_replace 1. MLA: q_lora_rank 576, kv_lora_rank 512, qk_nope_head_dim 128, qk_rope_head_dim 64, v_head_dim 128, mla_use_nope true, mla_use_output_gate true. Hybrid layout is explicit in rda_config: mla_layers [4,8,12,16,20,24,25] (entry 25 is out of range on a 25-layer model) and rda_layers the other 18; the complement of rda_layers is 0,4,8,12,16,20,24, so 7 layers carry a per-token KV cache (list has 7 entries; note entry 25 is 1-indexed in the card's own text and the config lists layer 24 as the last 0-based one). reasoning_effort_steering: six levels applied as steering vectors on layers [12,14,16,18,20], default 'high'; alpha 0.3 low / 0.1 medium / 0.05 high / 0.02 xhigh. raon_mhc_streams 4. Quantisation: mxfp8 block [1,32] dynamic, dequantize false, with attention/mlp/router/shared-expert weights ignored (kept bf16).
